item.title: The Gulf’s Cruise Market Has Lagged. That Could Soon Change
item.description: A unified visa and new regional coordination signal a turning point for one of the region’s slowest growing tourism segments.

item.title: Hilton Execs Bet on Luxury as Wealthy Travelers Fuel Global Boom
item.description: Hilton is finally converting years of luxury planning into actual hotel openings, targeting gaps in markets that competitors have left open.

item.title: Q&A: From Multi-Gen to Group Getaways – Evolving the Art of Staying Together
item.description: Group travel is entering a new golden age, fueled by travelers’ desire for connection, comfort, and flexibility. Evermore Orlando is redefining what it means to stay together, blending the best of vacation homes and luxury hotels through a philosophy of “residential hospitality” that caters to every generation.

item.title: Q&A: Closing the Personalization Gap in Travel
item.description: Travel’s personalization ambitions outpace its readiness. Closing that gap starts with unified, trusted data that serves as the foundation for real recognition, relevance, and loyalty.

item.title: Expedia Agrees to Buy Experiences Platform Tiqets to Bolster Its B2B Offering
item.description: Expedia's acquisition of Tiqets is the latest indication of the online travel agency's B2B tilt. It's certainly a niche that provides Expedia with an open lane.

item.title: Airlines Warn Green Jet Fuel Goals Are Falling Apart
item.description: Aviation's climate plans are unraveling, and airlines say Europe’s SAF mandates are making things worse.

item.title: Google’s Latest Test Could Erode Travel Search Referrals Even More
item.description: Google is collapsing the gap between quick answers and deeper chats in mobile search. For travel brands, this could mean more queries — from inspiration to booking — will run through conversational interfaces, not blue links.

item.title: Boom CEO: Powering AI Data Centers Will Speed Path to Supersonic Flights
item.description: Boom Supersonic is now providing turbines to data centers to help fuel the AI boom. The company’s CEO says the move won’t detract from its ambitions of reviving supersonic flight.

item.title: TUI Group Targets Nearly $300 Million in Cost Cuts
item.description: Artificial intelligence will play a role in TUI Group’s efforts to bring down costs within its markets and airline division.

item.title: India’s $72 Billion Wedding Season Is Reshaping Travel, Again
item.description: With every passing year, the budgets for Indian weddings are increasing as couples seek to make their big day more aligned to their personal tastes. Hotels, villas, palaces - all stand to benefit.
